meaning:
ὑπήκοος, -ον
(ὑπακσύω), [in LXX: Jhn.17:13 (לָמַם) Pro.21:28 (שָׁמַע), etc. ;]
giving ear, obedient, subject: Php.2:8; with dative of person(s), Act.7:39; εἰς πάντα, 2Co.2:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
